fields.postcondition: compiled key-handling delegates are initialized on demand per grain type and reused across subsequent grain persistence operations
fields.response: lazily initialize the compiled delegate per grain key and log a cache hit at Trace or a cache miss at Debug under event id MapperCacheStatus (4), naming the grain type: the database-backed provider reports OrleansDbCacheHit/Miss, and the shard provider reports OrleansShardCacheHit/Miss for every delegate it looks up, including the set-shard delegate its read path uses when it activates a default state whose shard key must be set from the grain id
fields.subject: Grain Persistence
fields.trigger: a read, write or clear operation looks up the compiled key-handling delegate for a grain type in its process-lifetime cache
